Aditya / team — reviewed Novus' redlines. High-level takeaways and recommended path: 

1) Liability cap: Novus wants $10M. We should avoid unlimited exposure. Recommend offering a fixed cap of $2M for pilot with option to re-evaluate at production (tie to annual ARR or committed spend). If they push, consider $5M absolute cap only after signed enterprise agreement and insured by a vendor-side POA.

2) Indemnity: Broad IP indemnity is risky. Propose limiting Redwood indemnity to willful infringement and carve out Novus-specific third-party data/processes; require claim notice and control of defense for Redwood. Add monetized liability caps to indemnity obligations.

3) Warranty: 24 months is excessive for a pilot. Counter with 90-day pilot warranty, 12-month warranty for GA. Offer service credits instead of extended warranty remedies.

4) Pricing: 20% off Y1 is steep. Recommend 10% off committed capacity for the pilot (on a 6-month commit) with a performance/usage-based kicker that can reduce effective price if they hit usage tiers. Offer additional discount credit tied to multi-year commit.

Recommended next step: route to CEO for exception approval on liability and indemnity carveouts and authorize commercial to offer a max 10% discount for pilot. I can draft the exact language for the exception if we get a green light.

Attachments: redline_summary.pdf (I highlighted the high-risk clauses inline).

Markus — short summary and ask below. This thread is in Aditya's mailbox; forwarding for your quick review.

Why this matters: Novus is a high-priority pilot (strategic vertical prospect) and timeline is aggressive (pilot start target 9/18). They are requesting three non-standard concessions that materially increase legal and financial exposure.

What they're asking:
- Liability cap increase to $10M (current standard: $500k for pilot)
- Broad indemnity including third-party IP (no carveouts)
- 24-month warranty with uptime remedies
- 20% year-one discount on committed spend

Risk and recommendation (short):
- Liability: exposure acceptable only with a clearly defined cap + insurance/POA. Recommend approval of a pilot-only cap of $2M (hard cap) with automatic review before GA.
- Indemnity: do NOT accept broad IP indemnity. Approve limited indemnity language (willful infringement only) + defense control protections.
- Warranty: approve 90-day pilot warranty only; offer 12mo at GA. Replace uptime remedies with service credits.
- Pricing: approve up to 10% pilot concession conditional on 6-month minimum commit and performance tiers.

Requested action: Please confirm approval for the above guardrails and instruct legal to finalize the concession language. If you approve, we'll present to Novus with a DocuSign-ready contract and a proposed commercial compromise.

I attached the redline and a one-page summary. If you want a 10-minute sync, I can join.
